en.title: Step-by-step guides for practical tasks
en.description: Step-by-step guides and practical notes, written for people who want the task done: set up a site, convert text between case styles and more.
en.intro: Each guide answers one question and shows the steps in the order you do them, with a table or an example you can check against your own work. Guides link to the tools that make a step faster. This demo hub shows one guide per page so the pagination links are visible; a real site keeps up to sixty members on the first page.

zh.title: 操作指南：一步一步把事情做完
zh.description: 一步一步的操作指南和实用笔记，写给想把事情做完的人：搭建站点、在各种大小写写法之间转换文字，以及更多内容。
zh.lede: 一步一步的操作指南和实用笔记。
zh.intro: 每篇指南回答一个问题，按你实际操作的顺序列出步骤，并附上表格或示例，方便你对照自己的结果。指南里会链接到能让某一步更快的工具。这个演示用的汇总页每页只放一篇指南，目的是让分页链接可见；真实站点的第一页最多放六十个条目。
